note: Ward calendar. Add an event by copying one block. date = YYYY-MM-DD; start/end = 24-hour HH:MM (leave out for all-day); kind = election, ward, or party. Past events hide themselves.

events.title: Last day to register to vote
events.details: Register or update your party and address before the November 3 election.

events.title: Last day to apply for a mail-in ballot
events.details: Apply online or at the county election office.

events.title: Election Day
events.details: Polls open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. Mail ballots must reach the county by 8 p.m. — not postmarked, received.
